title: Assistant Clinical Professor of Law
bio: Phil Torrey is an Assistant Clinical Professor of Law at Harvard Law School, where he has taught since 2011. He is also the Director of the Crimmigration Clinic at Harvard Law School. The Crimmigration Clinic engages in cutting-edge litigation on a range of issues concerning the intersection of criminal law and immigration law and teaches […]
